dialogs.about: 아침에 늦게 일어난 날, 할아버지과 알람 이야기

lines.en: Good morning. Did the alarm ring today?
No, I forgot to turn it on last night.
It's nine now. We slept too long!
lines.ko: 지금 아홉 시예요. 우리 너무 오래 잤어요!

lines.en: Sorry. Please open the curtain.
Look, the sun is bright this morning.
Where is my pillow? It isn't on the bed.
lines.ko: 내 베개 어디 있어요? 침대에 없어요.

lines.en: It's under the blanket, on the floor.
Thank you. I will turn on the alarm tonight.
Will you wake up early tomorrow?
Yes, I will wake up at six.

dialogs.about: 손주에게 아침 일찍 일어나는 법 알려주기

lines.en: Grandma, how do you wake up so early?
I go to bed early. I sleep at nine.
lines.ko: 일찍 잠자리에 들어요. 아홉 시에 자요.

lines.en: I went to bed late last night.
Put the alarm far from your pillow.
Why? I like it next to my bed.
lines.ko: 왜요? 저는 침대 옆에 두는 게 좋아요.

lines.en: You must get up to turn it off.
I will try it tonight, Grandma.
Good. Open the curtain in the morning, too.
Will the sun help me wake up?
Yes. This morning I woke up with the sun.
lines.ko: 네. 오늘 아침에 나는 해와 함께 깼어요.
